scientific_scope: Checkpoint inference reproducibility audit only. No training, tuning, calibration, model selection, threshold selection, or scientific result changes are permitted.

canonical_environment.pillow: historical exact version not recorded; runtime version must be reported, not claimed canonical

predeclared_parity_rules.categorical: All 96 POST-only argmax predictions and all 96 Siamese argmax predictions must match the sealed saved outputs exactly.

numerical.rule: All POST/Siamese logits and probabilities must satisfy numpy.allclose(atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5).

predeclared_parity_rules.failure_rule: If a predeclared criterion fails, do not change the tolerance post hoc. Preserve the outputs and investigate environment, Pillow preprocessing, source identity, CUDA behavior, and image bytes.

limitations: This tests frozen-checkpoint inference parity, not training-from-scratch reproduction.
Historical Pillow version was not recorded.
Final event-track expert evidence is Seed 42 only; no random-seed robustness claim.
